Open the workspace selector even when Mjolnir could auto-attach, or list and create workspaces without a terminal

Usage: mj workspaces [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  list    List the workspaces sessions can be created in
  create  Create a workspace, or select the one that already has the name
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -i, --instance <NAME>  Isolate configuration, database, daemon, and logs under `instances/<name>`. This is a different `mj` world, not a harness profile; explicit `MJ_CONFIG_DIR`/`MJ_DATA_DIR` still take precedence [env: MJ_INSTANCE=]
      --no-splash        Start the dashboard without the animated startup splash, for example over a slow remote connection [env: MJ_NO_SPLASH=]
  -h, --help             Print help
